short_bio:
I am an Associate Research Fellow at the Shenzhen Institute of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics for Society (AIRS), The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Shenzhen). I received my Ph.D. in Computer Science from the City University of Hong Kong, advised by Prof. Rynson W.H. Lau and Prof. Antoni B. Chan.

My research spans computational design, computer vision, and machine learning, with a focus on robotic 3D perception, spatial intelligence, and embodied world modeling. I develop geometry- and vision-based methods for precise robotic operation, dynamic reconstruction, and structured 3D scene understanding.

I have been recognized under Shenzhen's overseas high-level talent program (Category C) and the 深龙英才 talent program, and received the Outstanding Academic Performance Award from City University of Hong Kong twice. My work includes approximately 20 papers in venues such as ACM TOG (SIGGRAPH Asia), IEEE TMM, CVPR, and IEEE TVCG, alongside 15 Chinese patent applications and one US patent application.
